item.title: FBI searching 2 Pennsylvania homes in connection with NYC protests
item.description: The FBI and local police are investigating two homes in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, on Sunday afternoon in connection with protests in New York City on Saturday where two people were arrested for allegedly trying to set off improvised explosive devices.FBI searching Bucks County homesOfficials are serving warrants at two homes in Bucks County, north of Philadelphia — one in Middletown Township, the other near in Newtown Township.Officials said there was no threat to the public at either location
